Release & Publication

WorkflowDescription / PurposeTriggersKey Steps / Jobs
release.ymlMain release process for npm package (changesets). Creates release PR or publishes to npm. push maincheckout, setup Node/Python/Rust, install deps, build, changesets action → version or publish + summary job
release-crates.ymlPublishes Rust crates to crates.iopush main (paths: crates/vercel_runtime/**)publish job: cargo publish to crates.io
release-python-package.ymlPublishes Python packages to PyPI (trusted publishing) workflow_dispatchsetup Python/uv, runs python/publish.mjs
rollback-latest-tag.ymlRollback npm dist-tag `latest` to previous version.manual dispatchvalidate version, npm dist-tag add

CI & Testing

WorkflowDescriptionTriggersKey jobs
test.ymlMain test suite (unit + e2e tests) for PRspull_request to mainsetup (affected packages), unitTests, e2eTests, summary
test-lint.ymlLinters, format, changeset enforcementpull_requestenforce-changeset, lint (Biome, syncpack, type-check), lint-actions
test-python-packages.ymlPython packages tests across multiple Python versionspull_request (python/**)discover packages, run pytest on Python 3.12/3.13/3.14
cli-evals.ymlCLI evaluation tests using AI evalsPR / weekly cron / manualbuild + pnpm test:evals, upload results

Maintenance & Housekeeping

WorkflowPurposeTriggerAction / details
agentics-maintenance.ymlAuto‑close stale discussions/issues/PRscron (37 */2 * * *)gh-aw actions to close expired entities
ci-doctor.lock.ymlIntelligent failure diagnosis (GPT-5.1-codex-mini)on completion of E2E / Unit Testsanalyzes logs, creates diagnostic issue
discussions-auto-close.ymlRedirects GitHub Discussions → community.vercel.comdiscussion createdlock + close discussion via GraphQL API

Additional / Utility Workflows

WorkflowDescriptionTrigger(s)Key behavior
comment-cli-tarball.ymlPost instructions to test built CLI tarball on PRsrepository_dispatchresolves PR, comments npx command snippet
faster-template-prebuild-nextjs.ymlPre‑build & deploy Next.js example projectpush main / workflow_dispatchclone, vercel build, vercel deploy --prebuilt
update-remix-run-dev.ymlUpdate @remix-run/dev inside @vercel/remix-builderworkflow_dispatchutils/update-remix-run-dev.js → create PR
update-sandbox.ymlUpdate sandbox dependency in packages/cliworkflow_dispatchcheck version, update package & changeset, open PR
Workflow insights:
  • release.yml uses environment: release for PyPI trusted publishing & concurrency group per branch.
  • Turbo remote caching is enabled (TURBO_REMOTE_ONLY) for efficient builds.
  • ci-doctor.lock.yml is an agentic workflow (AI‑driven) that attempts to auto‑diagnose test failures.
  • The cron group ensures dependencies (Next.js, Gatsby fixtures, Turbo) are always fresh via automated PRs.
Based on vercel/vercel GitHub Actions (official repository). Diagram updated with all active workflows as of 2025.
